no hit to this HMM (outgroups are not searched)
FastTree tree of sugar transporters, rooted on GalP + AraE: the 272 clades of at least 100 tips, numbered by size. Positions show how clades nest, not branch length.
Grey wedges show the tips of clades with no numbered clade inside. Support is a flag, not a filter: low support means looking harder at that clade's own tree.
